description: Collectible outfits, grouped into collections. Group 1 (5 collections, 50 outfits) is decided; groups 2-6 exist as a theme roadmap only. Every premium outfit keeps a credible free path; time-only items (e.g. the Triumph Gown) carry no purchasable path by design.

_note.description: Design-team note; ignored by validation and importers.

acquisition.description: Free path is required; crowns_path is prose and may state that no purchasable path exists (time-only items).

scoring_categories.description: Player-visible scoring categories; weights stay hidden. Documented categories pending Beth's canonical list.

collections.description: Closet collections; outfits reference these by collectionId.

documented_scoring_categories.description: Design documentation; ignored by validation and importers.

documented_system_rules.description: Design documentation; ignored by validation and importers.

groups_roadmap.description: Future outfit groups; theme roadmap only, not importable content.

schemaVersion.description: Optional; when present must be the expected version. Missing versions log a warning on import.

story_wardrobe_references.description: Story wardrobe references, not confirmed collectible outfits; never auto-promoted.

title: Outfits
